title: Anatolian Crossroads: A Memory Graph from Neolithic Symbols to Iron Age Inscriptions (macro dataset)
description: Macro-level dataset of a two-level comparative digital-humanities network spanning 10 Anatolian and Upper Mesopotamian sites, 9600-700 BCE (Göbekli Tepe, Karahantepe, Sayburç, Çatalhöyük, Arslantepe, Kültepe-Kaneš, Hattuşa, Karkamış, Sam'al/Zincirli, Karatepe-Aslantaş). Sites connect only through geographic corridors, explicit comparative pairs and nine shared concept nodes; interpretive claims are isolated in an interpretation layer. Every node and edge carries sources and a four-tier confidence value (high/medium/low/speculative); no cultural-continuity relations exist in the schema. Files: full JSON dataset with bibliography, flat CSV node/edge tables, and four bilingual (EN/TR) story routes as sourced data. See docs/METHOD.md ("Modelling uncertainty across pre-literate and epigraphic networks") for the method note.
